skip_justification.reason: Component mismatch between check requirements and target codebase
details: Check CHK-W6B15-33-001 requires validation of RLP-encoded account data from P2P peers
RLP (Recursive Length Prefix) encoding is the serialization format used in Ethereum's Execution Layer for account state, transactions, and blocks
Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (beacon chain) implementation, as stated in its README: 'Prysm, a Golang implementation of the Ethereum Consensus specification'
The Consensus Layer does not directly handle or validate RLP-encoded account data - this is the responsibility of the Execution Layer client
Prysm only uses RLP for ENR (Ethereum Node Records) encoding in P2P discovery (beacon-chain/p2p/utils.go:45), which is standard libp2p functionality and unrelated to account data validation
Prysm connects to an external Execution Layer client via the Engine API (beacon-chain/execution/rpc_connection.go) and does not implement RLP parsing for execution-layer data structures

architectural_context.responsibility_boundary: Prysm delegates execution-layer concerns (including RLP validation of account data) to the connected EL client
relevant_files_checked: /home/gohan/runners/security-agent-2/_work/security-agent/security-agent/target_workspace/README.md - Confirms Prysm is a Consensus Layer implementation
/home/gohan/runners/security-agent-2/_work/security-agent/security-agent/target_workspace/beacon-chain/p2p/utils.go - Only RLP usage is for ENR encoding (line 45)
/home/gohan/runners/security-agent-2/_work/security-agent/security-agent/target_workspace/beacon-chain/execution/rpc_connection.go - Shows Prysm connects to external EL client via RPC
architectural_context.conclusion: RLP validation of account data from P2P peers is not within Prysm's code scope as a CL client. This check should be applied to Execution Layer clients (e.g., Geth, Erigon, Besu, Nethermind).

phase1_abstract_interpretation.recommendation: This check should be reassigned to an Execution Layer client codebase where RLP-encoded account data validation actually occurs.
